policy.release_claim_rule: A platform phase may claim release readiness only after its release_required targets pass the manual smoke script or the gap report marks the missing hardware as non-release-blocking for that phase.
policy.simulator_rule: Simulator or emulator evidence is acceptable for navigation, layout, auth, and fixture conformance but not for hardware codec, HDR, surround audio, remote-control, store-surface, or device-storage claims.
policy.best_effort_rule: Best-effort devices improve compatibility confidence but must not block the first platform release unless the platform phase explicitly claims support for that hardware class.
policy.evidence_retention: Store evidence as issue/PR artifacts, CI logs, or release notes; do not commit diagnostics bundles containing user-private data.

release_required: Current Android emulator or physical phone
Windows physical laptop for media/keyring smoke
NVIDIA SHIELD TV or NVIDIA SHIELD TV Pro physical evidence before a SHIELD high-capability claim

best_effort: Older Fire TV Stick class device

release_required: Recent Samsung Tizen physical TV or Remote Test Lab evidence
Xbox Series S or Series X physical console before public Xbox release
